title: Protocol for identification and validation of IGF2BP1 target genes in pluripotent human embryonic carcinoma cells
protocol: Remove the medium from the culture dish.
Wash the cells twice with 8 mL of ice-cold PBS.
Add 6 mL of ice-cold PBS supplemented with 1× complete protease inhibitor and 2 mM DTT to each 10-cm culture dish.
Irradiate the cells with 375 mJ/cm² at 254 nm using a UV Stratalinker 2400.
Harvest the UV-crosslinked cells using a cell scraper.
Centrifuge the tubes at 3,000 RPM (1741 × g) for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the cell pellet with ice-cold PBS supplemented with 1× complete protease inhibitor and 2 mM DTT.
Centrifuge the tubes at 3,000 RPM (1741 × g) for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Prepare lysis buffer by supplementing polysome lysis buffer (PLB) with 2 mM DTT, 1× complete protease inhibitor, 200 units/mL RNaseOUT, and 200 units/mL SUPERase IN.
Add 5-pellet volumes of freshly prepared lysis buffer to the pellets and gently resuspend by pipetting up and down for a few times.
Leave the tubes on ice for 10 min, then place them at -80°C overnight to complete the lysis.
Aliquot 50 μL of beads for each RIP into protein low binding tubes.
Place the tubes on a magnetic stand for 30 s.
Remove the solution from the tubes.
Wash beads 3 times with ice-cold PBS.
Add 500 μl of ice-cold PBS to each tube.
Resuspend the beads in ice-cold PBS by gently inverting the tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes briefly to collect residual beads from the cap.
Place the tubes on a magnetic stand for 30 seconds until the solution becomes clear.
Remove the supernatant.
Repeat steps (3ci – v) two times.
Incubate the beads with 250 μL of 5% (w/v) BSA in PBS on a rotator at 4°C for at least 2 hours.
Place the tubes on the magnetic stand until the solution becomes clear after blocking.
Remove the blocking solution.
Wash the beads with 500 μL of PLB twice.
Add 375 μL of PLB supplemented with protease inhibitor to the washed beads.
Add 5 μg of antibody (anti-IGF2BP1 or rabbit IgG) to maintain a concentration of 1 μg/75 μL PLB.
Incubate the antibody and beads on a rotator at 4°C for 2 hours.
Wash the bead-antibody complex with 1 mL of NT2 buffer five times.
Thaw cell lysates on ice.
Leave thawed cell lysates on ice for 5 minutes.
Spin samples at 16,000 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Collect the supernatant after centrifugation.
Measure the concentration of the lysate using Pierce Bradford assay according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Use 400 μg of cell lysate for each RIP.
Keep 10% of lysate as an input control at −80°C.
Add 400 μg of cell lysate to anti-FLAG M2 affinity beads or bead-antibody complex in Low binding tubes.
Incubate the reaction mixture on a rotator at 4°C overnight.
Centrifuge the tubes at 5,000 × g for 30 seconds at 4°C after incubation.
Wash the beads with 1 mL of ice-cold NT2 buffer supplemented with 1× complete protease inhibitor, 200 units/mL RNaseOUT and 200 units/mL SUPERase IN for five times.
Freeze 5% of the beads at −20°C for SDS-PAGE analysis after washing.
Resuspend the remaining beads in 200 μL of 1% SDS-TE buffer supplemented with 20 μg of Proteinase K.
Incubate RIP samples at 55°C for 30 minutes on a heat block.
Mix tubes every 5 minutes via inversion and brief centrifugation during incubation.
Thaw input lysates on ice while eluting RNA from RIP samples.
Place the tubes on the magnetic stand for 30 seconds after centrifugation of RIP samples.
Collect the eluent in fresh tubes after placing RIP sample tubes on the magnetic stand.
Add Trizol reagent to eluted RNA samples and input lysates at a ratio of 1:1.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5 minutes after adding Trizol.
Shake the tubes vigorously for 15 seconds after adding chloroform.
Incubate the tubes at room temperature for 3 minutes after shaking.
Centrifuge the tubes at 12,000 × g for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Pipette the top layer of aqueous phase containing RNA into new 2 mL tubes.
Prepare pre-mixed salt solution and keep it at room temperature.
Add pre-mixed salt solution to the RNA collected in step 6e.
Add ice-cold 100% ethanol to the mixture for RNA precipitation.
Vortex the tube for a few seconds after adding ethanol.
Store the tube at -80°C overnight for 18 hours.
Centrifuge the tube at 18,000 × g for 30 minutes at 4°C the next day.
Wash the RNA pellet with 1 mL of 75% ethanol.
Spin down at 18,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Repeat washing step once more.
Air-dry the RNA pellet at room temperature for 30 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 100 μL of DEPC water.
Add 100 μL of Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol to 100 μL of RNA.
Vortex for 1 min and centrifuge at 18,000 × g for 5 min.
Transfer the top aqueous phase to a new Eppendorf tube.
Add equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol to the transferred layer.
Vortex for 1 min and centrifuge at 18,000 × g for 5 min.
Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new 2 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 0.1 volume of 3 M Sodium Acetate (pH 5.2) and 3.5 μL of GlycoBlue to the tube.
Add 2.5 volumes of 100% ethanol, mix well, and store at −80°C overnight.
Centrifuge the tube at 18,000 × g for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash the RNA pellet twice with 75% ethanol.
Discard the supernatant after each wash.
Air-dry the RNA pellet at room temperature for 30 min.
Resuspend the pellet in DEPC water.
Use 10 μL of resuspended RNA for RIP and 30 μL for input samples.
Generate cDNA from RNA samples using iScript cDNA synthesis kit according to manufacturer's instructions.
Use 2 μL of RNA obtained from each RIP and input sample as templates for cDNA generation.
Incubate the reaction mix in a thermocycler with specified set-up.
Prepare master mix for qPCR reactions.
Make a 1:10 dilution of cDNA with nuclease-free water and use 4 μl for each qPCR reaction.
Perform triplicates for each reaction (3 wells for input, 3 for RIP, and 3 for control RIP).
Use iTaq Universal SYBR Green Supermix and QuantStudio3 Real-Time PCR systems for qPCR assay.
Vortex the master mix.
Spin down the master mix.
Add 16 μL of reaction mix to each well of MicroAmp™ Optical 96-Well Reaction Plate.
Add 4 μL of cDNA template to the corresponding wells.
Seal the plate with MicroAmp™ Clear Adhesive Film.
Vortex the sealed plate for a few seconds to mix reagents.
Centrifuge the plate at 3,000 RPM (1,741 × g) for 1 minute to spin down reagents and remove air bubbles.
Seed NTERA-2 cells at 2.5 × 10^6 cells per 10-cm culture dish in 10 mL of DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS.
Harvest NTERA-2 cells by trypsinization when the cells reach about 90% confluency.
Add 2.5 mL of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA per 10-cm culture dish.
Incubate at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 5–10 min.
Collect the detached cells in a 15-mL tube and spin down at 2,000 RPM (774 × g) for 5 min.
Remove the medium and wash the cell pellet with ice-cold PBS by resuspension in 1 mL of ice-cold PBS.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube for centrifugation at 2,000 RPM (774 × g) for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant and use the cell pellet for RNA extraction or store the pellet at -80°C.
Extract total RNA from the cell pellets with the Trizol reagent as described in step 6e.
Collect the aqueous layer containing RNA in a new 2 mL Eppendorf tube.
Precipitate the RNA by adding 0.1 volume of 3 M Sodium Acetate (pH 5.2), GlycoBlue (100 μg per mL as final concentration) and 2.5 volumes of 100% ethanol to the sample.
Mix the precipitated RNA solution thoroughly.
Keep at −80°C overnight.
Recover the RNA by centrifuging the tube at 18,000 × g for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash the RNA pellet with 1 mL of 75% ethanol.
Centrifuge at 18,000 × g for 10 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Air-dry the RNA pellet at room temperature for 30 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 150 μL of DEPC water.
Perform DNase I (QIAGEN) treatment of RNA to eliminate genomic DNA contamination.
Add a mixture of DNase I (5 μL) and RDD buffer (20 μL) to the RNA.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Do the RNA clean up as described in step 6f.
Resuspend the pellet in 85 μL of DEPC water.
Measure the RNA concentration using the Nanodrop Spectrophotometer.
Use 150 ng of total RNA as an input, and 3 μg of RNA for IP.
Prepare 50 μL of Protein A/G Dynabeads® per IP.
Transfer the beads to Low binding tubes.
Place the tubes on a magnetic stand for 30 s.
Remove the supernatant from the beads.
Wash the beads 3 times with 500 μL of ice-cold PBS per wash.
Add 250 μL of 0.5% BSA in PBS to the washed beads.
Add 10 μg of m6A antibody or rabbit IgG antibody to the beads.
Place the tubes on a rotator and incubate at 4°C for 2 h.
Wash the bead-antibody complex 3 times with 1 mL of IP buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl (pH 7.4), 750 mM NaCl and 0.5% NP-40).
Add 3 μg of RNA from step 10k to the bead-antibody complex in IP buffer supplemented with 200 units/mL RNaseOUT and 200 units/mL SUPERase IN.
Incubate on a rotator at 4°C overnight.
Place tubes containing RNA-antibody complexes on a magnetic stand after overnight incubation.
Wash the complexes 3 times with IP buffer in the same manner as step 3c.
Isolate RNA bound to m6A antibody.
Perform cDNA synthesis from precipitated RNA.
Conduct qPCR assay to ascertain if RNAs contain m6A modification.
Seed 0.5 × 10^6 NTERA-2 cells in 6-well culture plates for transfection.
Prepare triplicates for each siRNA target (IGF2BP1, METTL3, or METT14).
Transfect NTERA-2 cells with siRNAs targeting IGF2BP1, METTL3, or METTL14.
Transfect cells with siRNAs targeting IGF2BP1, METTL3, METTL14, or non-targeting control siRNA using jetPRIME according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Prepare the master mix for triplicates of each siRNA target.
Add 35 nM siRNA and 200 μL of jetPrime buffer to an Eppendorf tube.
Vortex the mixture for 10 seconds and spin down.
Add 4 μL of jetPrime reagent to the mixture.
Vortex for 1 second and spin down.
Incubate the reaction mixture for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add the reaction mixture to the cell culture plate in a dropwise manner.
Rock the plate gently after adding the mixture.
Incubate cells at 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 48 hours.
Trypsinize the cells from each reaction well 48 hours after transfection.
Seed one-fourth of the cells into a well of a 6-well plate for RNA extraction and three-fourths to a 6 cm dish for protein extraction.
Perform a second transfection with corresponding siRNA complexes 6-8 hours after seeding.
Harvest the cells by trypsinization 72 hours after the second transfection.
Store the cell pellets at -80°C.
Extract total RNA from frozen cell pellets using RNeasy Mini Kit and RNase-free DNase Set according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Perform cDNA synthesis from 1 μg RNA using iScript reverse transcription supermix for RT-qPCR.
Perform qPCR assay using iTaq Universal SYBR green kit and QuantStudio3 Real-Time PCR systems.
Calculate the fold-change in expression levels of target genes treated with siRNA targeting IGF2BP1 or methyl transferases compared to control cells using the 2−ΔCT method.
Normalize quantification against housekeeping gene GAPDH.
Prepare RIPA lysis buffer supplemented with Halt phosphatase inhibitor, Complete protease inhibitor, and PMSF.
Resuspend frozen cell pellets in RIPA buffer by gentle pipetting.
Incubate lysates on ice for 45 min.
Centrifuge lysates at 13,500 RPM (18,340 × g) for 15 min at 4°C.
Collect supernatant as cell lysate in a new tube.
Measure protein concentrations of lysates using the Pierce BCA Protein Assay kit.
Load 40 μg of protein into each well of an 8% SDS/PAGE gel.
Run the gel at 125 V for 2 hours using a PowerPac Basic Power Supply system.
Transfer proteins from the gel to PVDF membrane using a Mini Trans-Blot cell system at 30 V and 100 mA overnight in the cold room.
Block the membrane with 10% milk in PBS-T for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate the membrane with primary antibody diluted at a ratio of 1:1000 in blocking buffer at 4°C overnight.
Wash the membrane three times with PBS-T, each wash lasting 10 minutes.
Incubate the membrane with secondary antibody (HRP-conjugated anti-rabbit or anti-mouse) diluted at a ratio of 1:10,000 in blocking buffer for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash the membrane three times with PBS-T, each wash lasting 10 minutes.
Perform Enhanced Chemiluminescence detection using Radiance or Radiance Plus ECL reagent.
